text.p: The following are top stories from selected Singapore newspapers. Reuters has not verified these stories and does not vouch for their accuracy.
- China warns Japan against creating further incidents over the Diaoyu islands.
- South Korea's defence ministry says will seek to restart war games with the United States.
- Minister for Trade and Industry Yeo Cheow Tong says Singapore economy "on track" to achieve the 7 to 8 percent growth forecast.
- Delicatessen chain Delifrance and marine group Labroy Marine Ltd plan to list shares on the mainboard of the Stock Exchange of Singapore by end of year.
-Scotts Holdings announces a sharp Singapore $11.3 million loss for year ended June 30 and is in the red for first time since its listing five years ago.
- U.S. Federal Reserve leaves overnight bank lending rate at 5.25 percent.
- Judicial managers want former managing director Kang Hwi Wah of Amcol Holdings to buy back wholly-owned subsidiary Sankei Pte Ltd.
- Indonesia's Sinar Mas Group, in the process of acquiring Amcol Holdings Ltd, plans to use the Singapore-listed company to raise funds offshore and to boost exports.
